Frequently Asked Questions

?

How much does window cleaning cost?

Window cleaning prices vary based on the number of windows, property size, accessibility, and specific services needed. Most homes range from $150-$400 for a complete exterior cleaning. We offer free, no-obligation quotes tailored to your specific needs. Contact us today for an accurate estimate.

?

How often should I have my windows cleaned?

Most homeowners schedule window cleaning every 3-6 months, though this can vary based on your location, weather conditions, and personal preference. In Arizona's desert climate with dust storms and intense sun, we recommend cleaning every 3-4 months to maintain optimal clarity and prevent hard water spot buildup.

?

Do you clean both interior and exterior windows?

Yes! We offer both interior and exterior window cleaning services. You can choose one or both depending on your needs. Many customers prefer to have both done for a complete, crystal-clear result throughout their home.

?

What areas do you serve?

We proudly serve Mesa, Gilbert, Queen Creek, Chandler, and surrounding areas in the East Valley of Arizona. If you're unsure if we service your area, please contact us and we'll be happy to help.

?

Do you clean window screens?

Yes, we offer professional screen cleaning as an add-on service. We thoroughly clean screens to remove dust, pollen, pet hair, and debris, improving air flow and visibility. Screen cleaning is available for all our service packages.

?

Are your cleaning products safe for pets and children?

Absolutely! We use eco-friendly, non-toxic cleaning solutions that are safe for your family and pets. Our products are highly effective at removing dirt and grime while being gentle on the environment.

?

How long does a typical window cleaning take?

The time required depends on the size of your home and number of windows. A typical single-story home with 15-20 windows takes about 1-2 hours. Larger homes or multi-story properties may take 2-4 hours. We work efficiently while ensuring quality results.

?

Do I need to be home during the service?

While it's helpful if you're available to answer questions, you don't need to be home for exterior window cleaning. For interior cleaning, we'll coordinate with you to ensure access to all areas. We're fully insured and trustworthy professionals.
